question: Find the display names of users who are among the oldest (age equals the maximum age in the system), have posted at least one post with 1000 or more views, and have received at least one negative comment (score < 60) on their posts.

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_055" FROM users AS T1 WHERE T1."XCL_064" = (SELECT MAX("XCL_064") FROM users) AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT T2."XCL_033" FROM posts AS T2 WHERE T2."XCL_030" >= 1000) AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT T3."XCL_033" FROM posts AS T3 INNER JOIN comments AS T4 ON T3."XCL_026" = T4."XCL_006" WHERE T4."XCL_007" < 60)

eligibility.predicate: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE posts.XCL_033 = users.XCL_052 AND posts.XCL_030 >= 1000)
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts INNER JOIN comments ON posts.XCL_026 = comments.XCL_006 WHERE posts.XCL_033 = users.XCL_052 AND comments.XCL_007 < 60)

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_064" = (SELECT MAX("XCL_064") FROM users)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS T2
    WHERE T2."XCL_033" = T1."XCL_052"
      AND T2."XCL_030" >= 1000
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS T3
    INNER JOIN comments AS T4 ON T3."XCL_026" = T4."XCL_006"
    WHERE T3."XCL_033" = T1."XCL_052"
      AND T4."XCL_007" < 60
  )
